purpose: Materialized, committed, labeled calibration corpus for the measurement lane's reader-refusal classifier (Task 2). The runbook's qid-level adjudication summaries are NOT hypothesis-level and cannot score the classifier as-is (#2578 plan Failure Modes); this corpus is the hypothesis-level scoring surface. Agreement bars: >= 0.95 on committed-hedge, >= 0.95 on genuine-abstention. Drift-pin: a classifier change that breaks the documented #2027 hedge/abstention semantics fails the corpus test loudly.
assembled_from: committed #2027 hedge exemplars (tortoise/reader.py clause-scoped rule + canonical texts, reader.py:425/447/462-471/481-491)
product abstention fixtures (reader.py _ABSTAINED_PHRASES canonical phrasings, reader.py:427-440)
human-adjudicated eval-reader probes on temporal questions (runbook #2027 probes d6233ab6 preference-synthesis + gpt4_8279ba02 temporal day-count, test_reader_abstention_calibration.py docstring)
gold_semantics: gold=commit means the hypothesis ANSWERS the question (a trailing confidence hedge must NOT label it abstained — #2027); gold=abstain means the hypothesis refuses on genuine absence. The _abs question-id marker is EXCLUDED from the conversion channel (its abstention is correct); this corpus is hypothesis-level only.
